Liam B.: Opened PR to clarify resume token behavior across runtimes and add a tiny Go example showing decode + ctx cancel: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4366
Sofia M.: Nice. What's the change summary?
Liam B.: 1) Explicit Node/Deno decode variants; 2) Go: base64.StdEncoding.DecodeString example + context timeout; 3) Short note about pagination link anchor change; 4) small paragraph about how partial streamed bytes count for billing.
Arjun P.: Can you paste the Node + Deno decode snippets? Want to check wording.
Liam B.: Node:
```js
// Node
const decoded = Buffer.from(token, 'base64').toString();
// use `decoded` as cursor
```
Deno/browser:
```ts
// Deno/browser
const decoded = atob(token);
// use `decoded` as cursor
```
Sofia M.: Add a fallback note: try base64 decode and if it fails, use raw token. Some servers already return raw cursors.
Liam B.: Added. Also shortened the Go example to be copy-pasteable:
```go
ctx, cancel := context.WithTimeout(context.Background(), 6*time.Second)
defer cancel()
bs, err := base64.StdEncoding.DecodeString(token)
if err == nil {
  cursor := string(bs)
  // pass cursor in next request
}
```
Arjun P.: Lint/format? Prettier will force semicolons; black will wrap Python if we have one. I can run format once this lands.
Sofia M.: I also fixed the pagination anchor that was causing a 404 from the embeddings guide. Small wording tweak to the billing sentence.
